scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/finalize-build.ts && bun run build:react
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings packages examples website/.vitepress e2e scripts && prettier --check packages examples website e2e scripts *.json *.ts .prettierrc.json index.html README.md DECISIONS.md IMPLEMENTATION.md .github
scripts.format: prettier --write packages examples website e2e scripts *.json *.ts .prettierrc.json index.html README.md DECISIONS.md IMPLEMENTATION.md .github
scripts.docs:dev: bun run docs:api && vitepress dev website --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.docs:build: bun run typecheck && bun run docs:check-snippets && bun run build && bun run docs:api && vitepress build website
